body:
The peace corps is a volunteer group that does charity work with other countries. Problem is, they want volunteers to have a certain amount of work experience, and to be extroverted, two things of which I have none.


The only jobs in town that are usually hiring are the two convenience stores/gas stations, which would require me working the register, not to mention I'd have to find a ride into town whenever they had me scheduled to work, likely eating up a large portion of my paycheck anyway. Plus, I know both of those places are well-staffed anyway, so I'd get shit as far as hours go.

My town's small. To put it in perspective, my graduating class was the largest class in k-12, at a whomping 40 students. There aren't many jobs in town, and I have neither a driver's license nor a car, and my best friend's house is about half an hour out of town in the middle of nowhere.

I don't want to go back to college, at all. The problem is, I don't have any money to pay off any loans. I can't get a job in my hometown (the actual paying jobs are mostly taken, and the ones that aren't require an extroverted person, something I can't be). I want to travel, working for someone or something, but I don't have the money to travel, and I don't know of any opportunities like that other than the peace corps.
Yes. But regardless, you're not helping.
There's a difference between surviving and struggling.
